specialAbilities.name: Spider Climb
specialAbilities.description: The cave fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

specialAbilities.name: Adhesive Filament
specialAbilities.description: Its filaments are near invisible and stick to whatever touches them; a creature that walks into one has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). A filament has AC 15 and 5 HP.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cave fisher makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Filament
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13); the fisher reels it 25 feet toward itself.
